controllerIntegration: Instantiate exactly one GlobalInputKeymapOwner with the promoted SemanticCommandBus and TransientFocusOwner.
Declare workspace region descriptors in canonical focus order and supply them to WorkspaceRegionCycle.
Bind exactly one host/document keydown listener in Controller-owned integration code; forward each event plus current region, input-ownership and family keymap context to handleKeydown().
Structured editors must supply explicit inputOwnership descriptors; the global owner must not implement caret, shorthand, mutation, or editor history semantics.
Family contexts may supply createFamilyKeymapDescriptor() descriptors; semantics remain owned by their command owners and execute only through SemanticCommandBus.
Do not infer shortcut authority from visibility of shortcut UI/panels; every executable binding requires explicit allow policy.
Do not add a second Escape/transient stack owner; Escape delegates to TransientFocusOwner first.
Do not add a second global keydown semantic owner.
convergenceOrder: A input -> B feedback -> C context -> D bottom -> E scale
